findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Payroll.Rules.expensePolicy matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 0.58 (line 8); decimal literal 55.00 (line 9). Value 0.58 equals DEC-PY07.p1 (superseded by DEC-PY09). Value 55.00 equals DEC-PY08.p1 (accepted). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Finance: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
